how to be the smart academic girl
in school

1. read beyond the syllabus

one extra article a week
makes your essays stand out.

2. keep beautiful notes

not for aesthetics.
because you'll want to reread them.

3. sit where you can focus

front rows, away from the window.
little choices, big difference.

4. ask teachers what they love

their favourite topic
is usually the best lesson.

5. rest before exams

an early night beats
a last-minute all-nighter.
